title: Ensuring that Recent Increase in Petrol Prices Is Not Profiteering
what_it_is: Ensuring that Recent Increase in Petrol Prices Is Not Profiteering

sections.label: Rising pump prices and CCCS
sections.summary: Global and domestic pump prices rose due to Russia-Ukraine tension, with three retailers raising prices further while CCCS watches for anti-competitive behaviour.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Since the start of the year, global oil prices and domestic pump prices have been rising as a result of the Russia-Ukraine tension and retailers here have been adjusting their pump prices periodically.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Soon after the war broke out, three retailers raised pump prices further on 24 to 25 February, while the remaining two retailers did not adjust prices.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Overall, the increase in petrol and diesel prices reflect the rise in the price of crude oil over the past months.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: While pump prices are set by the market, the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore (CCCS) keeps a close watch to ensure an open and competitive market.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: If there is evidence of anti-competitive behaviour, such as coordinated price increases, CCCS will investigate and take firm enforcement action under the Competition Act.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Fuel Kaki, a retail petrol price comparison website, which is developed by the Consumers Association of Singapore (CASE), empowers consumers to compare not just the retail pump prices, but also the effective price of petrol across retailers, based on the various discounts and rebates applicable to them.

sections.label: Support package for drivers
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Government is considering a support package for private hire drivers, taxi drivers and private hire bus drivers amid steep fuel price rises.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In view of the steep rise in the price of petrol and diesel, is the Government looking at the prospect of a support package for private hire drivers, taxi drivers, private hire bus drivers, not too dissimilar from the aviation support package announced at this year's Budget to alleviate the cost of work for them?

sections.label: Willingness to roll out more
sections.summary: The speaker states that, as said in a previous Committee of Supply speech, they will not hesitate to roll out more.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As I have said in my previous Committee of Supply speech, we will not hesitate to roll out more.
